name: botnote
description: Notion for bots — capture + recall + project context for AI agents. Plugin connects to your botnote daemon's MCP endpoint and adds /today, /show-todo, /remember, /recall, /add-task, /start-work, /done slash commands and a curator subagent.

botnote_url.title: botnote daemon URL
botnote_url.description: Base URL of your botnote daemon, without a trailing slash, e.g. https://botnote.example.com. The default is a daemon on this machine. For any other URL also set botnote_token.

botnote_token.title: API bearer token
botnote_token.description: Required for any daemon that is not on this machine. Generate one in Settings -> API tokens. Leave empty for a local daemon that trusts loopback.
